description: Get full catalog metadata for a single scholarly work by OpenAlex id (e.g. 'W2741809807') or DOI (e.g. '10.1038/nature12373'). Returns title, authors, venue, year, citation count, open-access status, and a free full-text URL when available. For a bare arXiv id, use paper_get_text with paper_key 'arxiv:<id>' to read indexed text, or paper_search by title for OpenAlex metadata.

id.description: OpenAlex id ('W...') or DOI ('10.x/...'). For arXiv ids, use paper_get_text or paper_search instead.

name: paper_details
